summary: Enhance your skills with our Dashboard Usability and User Experience Course. Learn to create intuitive dashboards that improve user engagement and satisfaction.
lede: Dashboard usability training helps people who design, build, review, or manage dashboards make analytical interfaces easier to use. It covers mapping user tasks, organizing KPI information, selecting charts and interaction patterns, and testing dashboards with representative activities. Participants also practise assessing accessibility and turning usability findings into prioritised improvements using measures such as task completion, time on task, and errors.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who shape, build, review, govern, or rely on dashboards and need to improve user experience through structured design and testing.
prerequisites: You need basic comfort discussing business questions, metrics, and reporting workflows. Bring a laptop if possible; a browser-based workspace, sample dashboards, usability worksheets, and structured templates can support the exercises. You do not need to install software or write code. If you use Figma, Power BI, or Tableau in your role, you may bring a non-confidential dashboard example for critique, subject to your organization's data-sharing rules.
